name: Moe Wars: Research Team
source:
Crystal gets a vacation for the first times in years. She meets up with her friend Maria, and agrees to go test out the new REN program. The visual novel introduces characters, and explains the Moe Wars universe in funny storyline.

[From [url=https://renai.us/game/moewarsresearchteam]Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
translation:
克里斯托多年来第一次享受假期。她与朋友Maria会面，并同意去测试新的REN项目。这部视觉小说介绍了角色，并以有趣的故事情节解释了萌战宇宙。

[来自[url=https://renai.us/game/moewarsresearchteam]仁爱档案[/url]]
